programme.desc: The Joker's Hard Times. 1967. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Alan Napier. The Joker continues with his zodiac theme as the Dynamic Duo pursue him!

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: Fritz Lang began in Germany with Metropolis and M. He then built a new career following the Nazi uprising, moving to Hollywood to become the king of film noir.

programme.title: Crow Hollow
programme.desc: 1952. Drama. Director: Michael McCarthy. Stars Natasha Parry & Donald Houston. In a spooky mansion, one of three sinister spinsters tries to poison her nephew's wife to steal a large inheritance.

programme.title: Miss Robin Hood
programme.desc: 1952. Comedy. Henry is a mild man who writes adventure stories for his girls. All is fine until he meets Miss Honey! Starring Richard Hearne & Margaret Rutherford. Directed by John Guillermin.

programme.title: The Paper Gallows
programme.desc: 1950. Thriller. Directed by John Guillermin. Stars John Bentley, Dermot Walsh & Rona Anderson. A crime novelist, jealous over his secretary's affection for his brother, decides to murder her.

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: Knockout
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Directed by Blake Edwards. Stars Broderick Crawford, Ron Hargrave & Ted de Corsia. A young boxer finds, at the height of his career, that his championship fight has been fixed.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: The Thunderbolts - Part 1. 1973. Stars Ralph Arliss, Michael Sheard & Jimmy Gardner. Sergeant Goss is accused of malicious prosecution in a civil action brought by the leader of a gang of youths.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: The Thunderbolts - Part 2. 1973. Stars Kenneth Cranham, John Flanagan & Gabrielle Hamilton. Thunderbolts gang member John Tucker takes to the stand and Amanda Grant provides a witness statement.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: The Thunderbolts - Part 3. 1973. Stars David Webb & Barbara Hickmott. Francis Larwood and Sgt. Goss's pregnant daughter give character references on his behalf. The final witness is Goss himself.

programme.title: The Duchess of Duke Street
programme.desc: A Test of Love. 1976. Stars Gemma Jones, Christopher Cazenove, Anton Rodgers & Jan Francis. With the death of His Majesty, King Edward VII, an era ends for Britain and for Louisa Trotter.

programme.title: A Kid For Two Farthings
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Director: Carol Reed. Stars Diana Dors, Celia Johnson, David Kossoff, Brenda De Banzie. A boy, who's heartbroken when his pet chicken disappears, buys a goat believing it's a unicorn.

programme.title: Pollyanna
programme.desc: 2002. Drama. Directed by Sarah Harding. Stars Amanda Burton, Tom Bell & Kenneth Cranham. Young orphan Pollyanna, bringing mirth and mayhem to her new home, goes to stay with her Aunt Polly.

programme.title: Weir's Way
programme.desc: North East Scotland. 1985. Tom makes his way round the North-East of Scotland, visiting the coastal village of Gardenstown before moving on to his favourite fishing village, Pennan.

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: The Fall Guy. 1974. Stars Murray Hayne, Gabrielle Drake & Patrick O'Connell. The company goes public, and in an atmosphere of tension the share issue is placed on the market.

programme.title: Mark Saber
programme.desc: Cheating Cheaters. 1958. Stars Donald Gray, Bernard Bresslaw & Ian Fleming. John Seaton and two men attempt to con a blind philanthropist. The suspicious family solicitor calls in Mark Saber.

programme.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
programme.desc: Episode 27. 1975. Sheila Southern performs 'Sing', and Terry Lightfoot and his band perform four numbers. Pat Mooney, Wee Willie Harris and Stu Francis also feature.

programme.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles (2002)
programme.desc: 2002. Drama. Director: David Attwood. Stars Richard Roxburgh, Ian Hart & Richard E. Grant. Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson investigate after being told an heir's estate is plagued by a ghostly dog.

programme.title: The Nudist Story
programme.desc: 1960. Drama. Director: Ramsey Herrington. Stars Shelley Martin, Brian Cobby, Natalie Lynn. A woman is horrified when she inherits a nudist camp but her views are challenged when she falls in love.

programme.title: The Restless Breed
programme.desc: 1957. Western. Director: Allan Dwan. Stars Scott Brady, Anne Bancroft, Jay C. Flippen. A young lawyer travels to Mission, a small Texas border town, to even the score for the murder of his father.

programme.title: Look At Life Healing Hands
programme.desc: 1960. A look at the dedicated research carried out behind the scenes of medicine and the onward march of surgery.

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Respectable Suicide. 1963. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & June Watts. A wealthy man takes his life, his will states that his money is left to his housekeeper not his wife.

programme.title: Burke's Law
programme.desc: Who Killed the Fat Cat? 1965. Stars Gene Barry, Gary Conway & Regis Toomey. A shady conglomerate owner dies, and the figurehead presidents of his corporations are all under suspicion.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Penguin Declines. 1967. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Alan Napier. As the Joker and the Penguin's zodiac theme become even more grandiose, the Dynamic Duo's dissolution becomes its goal.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: That Darn Catwoman. 1967. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Alan Napier. Catwoman mind controls Robin! The Caped Crusader must stop her before she does who knows what with him!

programme.title: Links of Justice
programme.desc: 1958. Drama. Director: Max Varnel. Stars Jack Watling, Sarah Lawson & Robert Raikes. Edgar Mills and his mistress Stella plot to murder Edgar's wealthy wife Clare, but things do not go to plan.

programme.title: River Beat
programme.desc: 1954. Crime drama directed by Guy Green. A radio operator is duped into smuggling diamonds and is caught by Customs Detective Baker (John Bentley). Starring Phyllis Kirk and Bill Nagy.

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: Second Dawn
programme.desc: 1954. Drama. Directed by Roy Kellino. Stars Charles Boyer, Dorothy Hart & Luis Van Rooten. A man born without sight is given a life changing opportunity for surgery to restore his sight.

programme.title: To Have And To Hold
programme.desc: 1951. Drama. Director: Godfrey Grayson. Stars Avis Scott, Patrick Barr & Robert Ayres. Following a riding accident, a countryman spends his final days arranging the future security of his family.

programme.title: Becoming Cary Grant
programme.desc: 2017. Director: Mark Kidel. Cary Grant, one of Hollywood's greatest stars, was troubled most of his life with self doubt and insecurity. In his fifties he began taking LSD to exorcise his demons.

programme.title: Doctor In Clover
programme.desc: 1966. Comedy. Directed by Ralph Thomas. Stars James Robertson Justice, Leslie Phillips, Shirley Anne Field. Gaston Grimsdyke enrols on a medical course run by Sir Lancelot Spratt.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1961. The Silent Weapon. Directed by Peter Duffell. Staring Geoffrey Keen, Stanley Morgan and Norma Parnell. A horse rider is found dead in suspicious circumstances. (S1, E35)

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Wager. 1956. Starring: Alexander Gauge, Geoffrey Keen & George Rose. Friar Tuck and Robin bet to see who can raise more money. Robin will dress and act as a beggar.

programme.title: Three Coins in the Fountain
programme.desc: 1954. Romantic Comedy. Director: Jean Negulesco. Stars Dorothy McGuire & Jean Peters. Three women toss coins into Rome's Trevi Fountain for luck in romance. But none have the luck they hoped for!

programme.title: Ships Reporter British Stars 1951
programme.desc: Jack Mangan interviews a host of British stars including Francis L. Sullivan, Michael Wilding, Anna Neagle and Herbert Wilcox, all aboard a ship.

programme.title: A Family At War
programme.desc: 1971. I Wanted to be with You. Stars Colin Douglas & Shelagh Fraser. The whole family gathers for Phillip's Birthday. Freda's boyfriend is introduced for the first time. (S2, E18)

programme.title: Chase a Crooked Shadow
programme.desc: 1958. Thriller. Director: Michael Anderson. Stars Anne Baxter, Richard Todd & Herbert Lom. At Kimberley's villa, a stranger shows-up & claims he is her brother who she thought to be dead.

programme.title: Look At Life Looking For Nothing
programme.desc: 1960. A look at a number of different sights, including the Manchester Whitweek walks, liners, pet-shop windows and holes.

programme.title: Public Eye
programme.desc: 1975. Detective & Mystery Drama. The Fall Guy. Stars Alfred Burke, Peter Childs & Ronald Lewis. A girl brings more than beauty into Marker's life when he gets mixed up with the Lord of the Manor.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro introduces Hammer's classic 1958 version of Dracula, written by Jimmy Sangster, directed by Terence Fisher and starring horror legends Peter Cushing and Christopher Lee.

programme.title: Dracula (1958)
programme.desc: 1958. Horror. Director Terence Fisher. Stars Peter Cushing, Christopher Lee & Melissa Stribling. After Dracula defeats a vampire slayer, he pursues his wife.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: After the wonderful yet terrifying film, Caroline Munro prepares to close up The Cellar Club for the night but not before some interesting facts about Dracula (1958).

programme.title: Play For Today: The Flipside of Dominick Hide
programme.desc: 1980. Director: Alan Gibson. Stars Peter Firth, Caroline Langrishe & Pippa Guard. Dominick is a time traveller from Earth's future who is searching for an 'ancestor'.

programme.title: Paul Oakenfold
programme.desc: Legendary DJ and producer Paul Oakenfold kicks off the weekend with three hours of the biggest tunes and stories from his extraordinary career.

programme.title: Fist of Fury
programme.desc: Martial arts drama starring Bruce Lee. Karate pupil Chen Chen returns to Shanghai for the funeral of his former teacher. When he discovers that his mentor was in fact murdered, Chen sets out to avenge his death.

programme.title: Five Corners
programme.desc: Thriller starring Jodie Foster and Tim Robbins. A young woman alienates her disabled boyfriend by seeking protection when an ex-convict who tried to rape her returns to the area. After a teacher's murder, for which the former prisoner is a suspect, the woman places herself in danger by agreeing to meet her attacker again.

programme.title: Cheer for Your Life
programme.desc: A high school girl's spirits are crushed as she suffers through a humiliating 'Initiation', but her dreams aren't the only thing in danger when another girl on the squad turns up dead, and when she disappears herself, her mom will have to rush to save her

programme.title: Gorgo
programme.desc: Monster adventure starring Bill Travers and William Sylvester. A prehistoric monster is captured off the coast of Ireland and brought to London where it is exhibited in a circus. But having determined that the monster is an infant, scientists suspect that one of its parents may also still be alive.

programme.title: My Dad Is Scrooge
programme.desc: A boy is shocked when his grouchy father gives a farmer a foreclosure notice just before Christmas. He wakes up one night to discover the farmyard animals in his room, who reveal they can talk and offer to help him play a trick that will teach his dad the importance of Christmas spirit. Festive fantasy, starring Brian Cook and Christian Laurian Kerr

programme.title: Journey to the Christmas Star
programme.desc: A teenage girl living in a kingdom that has been cursed ventures into a sinister dark forest in search of a lost magical star - the only thing that can break the enchantment and return the king's missing daughter. However, an evil witch intends to stop her and seize the throne herself. Fantasy adventure, starring Vilde Marie Zeiner and Anders Baasmo Christiansen. In Norwegian

programme.title: Maya the Bee: The Honey Games
programme.desc: An overenthusiastic bee accidentally embarrasses an empress, and is forced to take part in a contest to save her hive. Animated adventure, with the voices of Coco Jack Gillies, Benson Jack Anthony and Richard Roxburgh

programme.title: Perfect Wedding
programme.desc: When two event planners are forced to work together to organise a wedding for an engaged couple that cannot agree, they learn that opposites can produce the most unexpected results. Comedy, starring Danica McKellar, Paul Greene and Linda Gray

programme.title: Northpole
programme.desc: Seasonal fantasy starring Tiffani Thiessen and Max Charles. With everyone now seemingly too busy to enjoy Christmas the way they used to, Santa's home and livelihood come under threat. But young Kevin still believes, and together with his teacher and some new friends sets out to show just how magical the festive season can be.

programme.title: A Handful of Dust
programme.desc: Period drama starring James Wilby and Kristen Scott Thomas. Brenda Last has everything that other women would envy - a loving and aristocratic husband, an adorable son and a huge stately home in the country. But for an amusing diversion, Brenda starts an affair with a social-climbing scrounger from London. It is the start of an inexorable slide to disaster.

programme.title: Keep the Aspidistra Flying
programme.desc: Period romantic comedy based on the satirical novel by George Orwell, starring Richard E Grant and Helena Bonham Carter. When a successful copywriter abandons his career to become a poet, it's up to his long-suffering girlfriend to keep their relationship on the rails.

programme.title: Dragon Warriors
programme.desc: Evil wizard Lord Tensley (James Marsters) despatches everyone in his realm who has fallen in love... by sending down a fire-breathing dragon. He promises to call off the creature if his true love - Princess Ennogard (Kaitlin Doubleday) - succumbs to his fiery blandishments. However, she puts out an SOS call to an unlikely group of heroes, led by the laid-back hero Ramicus (Adam Johnson) and his estranged brother Camilan (Maclain Nelson). But will they be too late?

programme.title: Hijacked
programme.desc: A special agent discovers a private jet is about to be hijacked by the henchmen of a crime lord he is trying to bring to justice. He manages to get on board the aircraft and fights to save the passengers - who include his ex-fiancee. Action thriller, starring Randy Couture, Dominic Purcell and Craig Fairbrass

programme.title: The Last Man
programme.desc: After a street preacher believes the world is going to end via an electrical storm, Kurt, a combat veteran suffering from PTSD, builds a secret underground shelter beneath his cramped apartment. He pays for it with a a job at a shady security firm, where he soon begins a romance with the boss' daughter. Drama, starring Hayden Christensen, Harvey Keitel and Liz Solari

programme.title: Desolation
programme.desc: Joined by her son and her best friend, a woman heads into the remote wilderness to scatter her late husband's ashes, only to discover that they're being stalked by a hiker. Thriller, starring Toby Nichols

programme.title: Escape from Polygamy
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Haley Lu Richardson and Jack Falahee. A young woman falls madly in love with the son of the leader of the strict religious community in which they live, leading to conflict within their families and their faith.

programme.title: Father's Little Dividend
programme.desc: Comedy starring Spencer Tracy, Joan Bennett and Elizabeth Taylor. Stanley Banks is looking forward to some peace and quiet now that his daughter is married. But his plans are disrupted when she announces that she is going to have a baby.

programme.title: A Cinderella Christmas
programme.desc: Romance starring Emma Rigby and Peter Porte. Put-upon party planner Angie meets handsome bachelor Nikolaus at a masked ball. But after she leaves without telling him who she is, Nikolaus is determined to track her down.

programme.title: A Puppy for Christmas
programme.desc: A woman loses her job, her flat and her boyfriend just before Christmas - all thanks to her mischievous pet dog. A co-worker invites her to come and spend the holiday with him on his farm, and the experience leaves her torn between pursuing a new life in the country or trying to rebuild her old city life. Festive romantic comedy, starring Cindy Busby, Greyston Holt and Christopher Russell

programme.title: An Eskimo Tale
programme.desc: When animals start mysteriously disappearing, three young Inuits embark on a perilous journey to save their tribe from ruin. Animated adventure, with the voice of Christopher Plummer

programme.title: Meet Me in New York
programme.desc: Kelly is a young, creative, ambitious events planner in New York City and quickly gaining a reputation as one of the best in the business. But when Joe, a stubborn, difficult, but influential website editor, hires her to organize his niece's 10th birthday party, Kelly quickly realizes that she may have just met her match.

programme.title: A Song for Christmas
programme.desc: Seasonal romance starring Kelli Williams and Jonathan Scarfe. Two single parents start to fall in love only to learn that their daughters are arch rivals at school.

programme.title: David Copperfield
programme.desc: Classic period drama based on the novel by Charles Dickens, starring WC Fields, Lionel Barrymore and Freddie Bartholomew. David Copperfield's idyllic life with his adoring mother changes radically when she falls under the influence of the tyrannical Mr Murdstone.

programme.title: Lassie Come Home
programme.desc: Florian and his beloved Collie Lassie are inseparable and live happily in an idyllic village. When Florian's father loses his job, the family move to a flat and Lassie's placed in the hands of Count von Sprengel, although when his mean caretaker starts treating Lassie badly, she escapes and searches for Flo, not knowing Flo also can't stand it any longer and is looking for his dog. Adventure, starring Nico Marischka

programme.title: The Efficiency Expert
programme.desc: An English efficiency expert is drafted in to examine the work practices at a run-down shoe factory in the backwater Australian suburb of Spotswood, where his presence soon causes all manner of complications. Comedy, starring Anthony Hopkins, Ben Mendelsohn, Alwyn Kurts and Bruno Lawrence

programme.title: Interstate 60
programme.desc: James Marsden stars as a man unsure of where his future will take him. When he blows out the candles on his birthday cake, his wish for some answers to life's many questions is surprisingly granted in the shape of a mystical leprechaun (Gary Oldman) who guides him on a surreal journey of self discovery. Bob Gale's fantasy comedy, featuring a star-studded list of cameos including Michael J Fox, Kurt Russell, Liv Tyler and Christopher Lloyd

programme.title: Say Your Prayers
programme.desc: Two orphaned brothers-turned-radical-Christian hitmen venture to rural Ilkley, under the instruction of the clergyman who raised them, Father Enoch. Their mission is to assassinate Professor John Huxley, a famed atheist writer. Crime comedy, starring Tom Brooke, Harry Melling, Roger Allam and Derek Jacobi

programme.title: Date Movie
programme.desc: Romantic comedy spoof starring Alyson Hannigan and Adam Campbell. Julia Jones's parents would like her to settle down with a nice boy who shares her Greek-African-American-Indian-Japanese heritage. But Julia has her sights set on wet-but-handsome Englishman Grant Funkyerdoder, who has no idea what he's letting himself in for.

programme.title: The Terror
programme.desc: A young French soldier cut off from his unit in Napoleon's army is beguiled by a mysterious woman, whom he learns is the wife of an elderly Baron - and that she seemingly died twenty years earlier. Horror, starring Boris Karloff and Jack Nicholson

programme.title: Journey to the Christmas Star
programme.desc: A teenage girl living in a kingdom that has been cursed ventures into a sinister dark forest in search of a lost magical star - the only thing that can break the enchantment and return the king's missing daughter. However, an evil witch intends to stop her and seize the throne herself. Fantasy adventure, starring Vilde Marie Zeiner and Anders Baasmo Christiansen. In Norwegian

programme.title: A Perfect Christmas
programme.desc: Romantic fantasy starring Claire Coffee and Ryan McPartlin. Young executive Holly Maddux wakes after a fall to find that the hunky mannequin she admired in a department store window has come to life and is by her side. Love blossoms, but Holly soon discovers that being perfect all the time is hard work.

programme.title: Married by Christmas
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring April Bowlby and Jes Macallan. When two sisters discover that their father's company will be inherited by whichever one marries first, the sister who has worked to build the business begins a frantic search for a husband.

programme.title: Royal Wedding
programme.desc: Musical comedy chronicling the adventures of a brother-and-sister dance team performing in London at the time of the then Princess Elizabeth's wedding. Starring Fred Astaire, Jane Powell, Peter Lawford and Keenan Wynn

programme.title: Coffee Shop
programme.desc: A coffee shop owner tries to save her struggling business from closure, a crisis she keeps a secret from her friends. Her life is made even more complicated when her ex-boyfriend returns hoping to get back together, challenging her feelings for a Broadway playwright. Romantic comedy, starring Laura Vandervoort and Cory M Grant

programme.title: 12 Days of Giving
programme.desc: Seasonal romance starring Ashley Jones and David Blue. A photographer uses his new-found wealth to act as a secret Santa to his community, and his acts of kindness bring him close to a single mother.

programme.title: Made for You with Love
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Edy Ganem and Brendon Zub. A dressmaker who makes a living by upcycling second-hand wedding gowns discovers that fixing her love life is a trickier task.

programme.title: A Horse for Spring
programme.desc: Riley Adams’s dreams of being a world class elite dancer are shattered following an horrific accident. A surprising act of kindness from a most unexpected place helps Riley discover the power of faith, friendship and love in this charming tale. AKA Healed by Grace

programme.title: Paper Tiger
programme.desc: Comedy adventure starring David Niven and Toshiro Mifune. "Major" Bradbury is a naturally timid man who has invented a heroic past for himself - the last thing he expected was to become involved with ruthless terrorists and experience a dangerous situation first hand.

programme.title: Kids in Love
programme.desc: A student drifting through his gap year befriends a group of bohemians and gets drawn into their hedonistic world. He gives up everything to embrace their chaotic lifestyle, realising too late what he may have lost and that his new friends may not have his best interests at heart. Drama, starring Will Poulter and Alma Jodorowsky

programme.title: Eternal Love
programme.desc: A New York twentysomething named Elliot lives with his best friend Nico. The duo work at jobs they don't like and hit the clubs at night. After discovering he has cancer, Elliot falls for Mia, a customer at the sandwich shop where he works, and their blossoming relationship soon faces the ultimate test. Comedy drama, starring Jeremy Allen White and Maika Monroe

programme.title: Beyond the Law
programme.desc: When alcoholic ex-detective Frank Wilson learns of his estranged son's murder, he hits the streets on a crusade for justice, and winds up taking on the mob. Director James Cullen Bressack's thriller, starring DMX, Steven Seagal and Johnny Messner

programme.title: Behind the Wheel of Revenge
programme.desc: Inspired by true events. 17-year-old Kim, a model student bound for Stanford, sees her boyfriend flirting at a party and makes a terrible choice: she finds where his parents hid the car keys. Moments later, Kim crashes, nearly killing a classmate. While Kim is held accountable, the town and police also blame her boyfriend's parents for supplying the alcohol.

programme.title: The Lady Vanishes
programme.desc: Classic thriller starring Margaret Lockwood and Michael Redgrave. One moment Miss Froy was sitting there, on the London-bound train from the Tyrol. The next she had vanished. Some passengers claimed she was never there, but Iris Henderson is convinced that she saw her. Was it her imagination?

programme.title: 12 Days of Giving
programme.desc: Seasonal romance starring Ashley Jones and David Blue. A photographer uses his new-found wealth to act as a secret Santa to his community, and his acts of kindness bring him close to a single mother.

programme.title: Karen Kingsbury's The Bridge
